bug_semantics: SitemapLoader.parse_sitemap recursively follows nested sitemap-index <sitemap><loc> entries by calling self.scrape_all([loc.text], "xml") (WebBaseLoader / aiohttp GET) with no same-domain comparison and no private/loopback/link-local block. restrict_to_same_domain (default True after #11925) is applied only in the leaf <url><loc> loop. An attacker who can influence an ingested sitemap can nest an internal URL, force the server to fetch it even when the app set restrict_to_same_domain=True, and receive the parsed body in returned Documents (CWE-918 SSRF with disclosure). Distinct from CVE-2024-2965, which only capped recursion depth.
flaw_origin: Smallest surviving public first-write of the unguarded nested-sitemap fetch is 7e79f8c136452cbde767ea9a80e4a4caed23fd16 (PR #3146 squash onto master: Support recursive sitemaps in SitemapLoader). Parent 215dcc2d26679c84b6daacde5d4ebd466f7c30c5 already has langchain/document_loaders/sitemap.py with a leaf <url> loop and optional filter_urls, but no for sitemap in soup.find_all("sitemap") and no soup_child = self.scrape_all([loc.text], "xml")[0]. Sibling retakes e8e8ca163b and 3d762f2b8b reuse the same seven-line sitemap.py blob on other parents and are not master ancestors. 90e9ec6962 later added restrict_to_same_domain only on leaf urls and left the nested scrape_all call unchanged (incomplete control, not the first-write). Later max_depth (CVE-2024-2965) and the community extraction still left loc.text unfiltered on the nested path.

Last in-tree copy before community extraction (9ff5b5d282^:libs/community/langchain_community/document_loaders/sitemap.py) still fetches nested loc.text then parse_sitemap(..., depth+1) with no domain check. No later sitemap.py commit in this clone applies the leaf domain comparison to nested entries. langchain-ai/langchain#38814 (external, community) documents the bypass and a working PoC; CNA tags unsupported-when-assigned and patched versions Unknown.
reasoning: Real CWE-918: nested sitemap locs are fetched without the documented same-domain control. BIC is the human first-write of that nested scrape (Hartmann / #3146), not the later leaf-only restrict_to_same_domain commit and not the community move. BIC object has no AI authorship marker, so the origin is human. No nested-domain fix SHA exists in this clone; community was split out and left unpatched.
remaining_gap: Unpatched in this clone and in archived langchain-community (<=0.4.2; patched versions unknown). Potential fix: before nested scrape_all, apply the same _extract_scheme_and_domain(self.web_path) check used on leaf urls, and refuse private/loopback/link-local/non-http(s) destinations; then recurse only on allowed locs. Reference: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/issues/38814 ; no upstream fix commit.
